summary: CheerPlanner AI Designer (Team Hub) — backend + frontend end-to-end verified. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (access control 403 for non-staff, 401 unauth, empty-prompt/empty-save 400, real OpenAI GPT-Image-2 generate returns base64 in ~13s, save→list→get→delete→404 flow persists correctly). Frontend on mobile viewport 390x844 as demo@cheerplanner.app: navigated to /team/ai-designer, entered prompt, tapped Generate → loading indicator shown, image rendered (~15-30s), Save changed button to 'Saved', Regenerate & Share present, Share triggered web download (cheerplanner-design-*.png), Library sheet opened and showed the saved design with delete button, delete cleanup succeeded. Non-staff (sophia.athlete@cheerplanner.app) is blocked at the API layer (backend 403) as required.
action_items: OPTIONAL/UX (not blocking): The /team/ai-designer route currently renders the full AI Designer UI for a non-staff user who reaches it via direct URL (backend still 403s any generate/save calls). Consider adding a frontend guard (redirect or 'Coaches & staff only' empty state) on this route for parity with backend gating.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_designer.py L71-72: substring match on 'model' with 'not' OR 'access' could produce false-positive 503s for unrelated OpenAI errors (e.g., 'model=... does not exist'). Current mapping still yields a reasonable user message so keeping as-is.
ai_designer.py L94: broad Exception catch on base64.b64decode swallows all decode issues into HTTP 400 with generic message — acceptable.
ai-designer.tsx L82-86: openLibrary swallows list-fetch errors silently (empty list). Consider surfacing a toast if load fails.
ai-designer.tsx L89: openDesign sets `saved = true` optimistically before the fetch resolves; if the fetch fails the user sees Save button as 'Saved' with no image. Minor UX polish.
seed_data_creation: Test created a single design during pytest (cleaned up via delete). Frontend Playwright test created a single design and deleted it. Demo account library is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_ai_designer.py (pytest, ~17s incl. one real OpenAI call). Frontend testIDs available: ai-designer-screen, ai-designer-back, ai-designer-library, ai-designer-prompt, ai-designer-generate, ai-designer-loading, ai-designer-image, ai-designer-regenerate, ai-designer-save, ai-designer-share, ai-designer-error, ai-designer-library-sheet, ai-design-<id>, ai-design-del-<id>. Login flow: land on marketing → click 'Sign in' text (top nav) → fill email/password → click the 'Sign in' button (there are two 'Sign in' text nodes, pick the visible one at idx 1). Onboarding tour modal may appear — dismiss with Skip. Generate can take 10-40s; wait up to 90s.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All targeted flows work as specified.
